title: HalluProbe: Exploiting VLM Hallucinations for Backdoor Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.19868v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are vulnerable to backdoor attacks introduced through data poisoning, making effective backdoor detection a critical security challenge. In this paper, we uncover a novel connection between VLM hallucinations and backdoor behaviors and exploit this connection for backdoor detection. Our key insight is that poisoned training data induces strong language priors toward the backdoor target token, while such priors are also a major source of hallucinations. This suggests that enhancing hallucinations can expose hidden backdoor-related priors. Specifically, backdoored VLMs tend to hallucinate backdoor target tokens more frequently across diverse inputs, while the hallucinated tokens of clean VLMs are largely random and exhibit no stable target-specific bias. translated_title: HalluProbe：利用视觉语言模型的幻觉进行后门检测
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型容易受到通过数据投毒引入的后门攻击，这使得有效的后门检测成为一项关键的安全挑战。在本文中，我们揭示了视觉语言模型幻觉与后门行为之间的新联系，并利用这一联系进行后门检测。我们的核心洞察是：被投毒的训练数据会诱导出指向后门目标词元的强语言先验，而这种先验同时也是幻觉的主要来源之一。这表明，增强幻觉可以暴露隐藏的与后门相关的先验。具体而言，被植入后门的视觉语言模型在多样化输入下更倾向于幻觉出后门目标词元，而干净模型的幻觉词元在很大程度上是随机的，不表现出稳定的目标偏向性。基于这一观察，我们提出了HalluProbe，该方法在输出解码过程中增强幻觉，并测量幻觉的分布一致性（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出HalluProbe，其创新在于揭示了后门攻击引入的目标词元语言先验与模型幻觉同源这一联系，通过在解码时增强幻觉并检测幻觉分布中的稳定目标偏向性，实现对视觉语言模型后门的有效检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes HalluProbe, which detects backdoors in Vision-Language Models by exploiting the novel connection between hallucinations and backdoor behaviors—enhancing hallucinations during decoding and identifying stable target-specific biases in hallucinated tokens that expose hidden backdoor-related language priors.
